For every p>0 there is r_* such that for every ell>=r_* there exist finite binary V containing K=F2^ell, K-equivariant C:V->K, and rational noise mu with Pr[C(x+a)!=C(x)]<=p for uniform independent x, and Pr[exists g in G:g(a)!=0]>=1/8 for every G<=V* with dim(G restricted to K)>=r_*.

For every t>=0 the manuscript recursion has nonlinear change probability p_t=(1-q^(-3))(1-theta)^t for theta=1/(q^2+q+1), with independent uniform initial aggregate conditional on the selected update.

Every parent lift factors through one binary-linear gamma:S->X* common to all outgoing (A,J); a uniform incoming J makes the next image domain uniform conditional on its rank, even if its induced lift depends on J.

Under the manuscript genericity and fresh-orientation bounds, every full lift on P_s for s=floor(H_r0/(8 theta)) detects the leaf noise with probability at least 1/4, for every r0 and every adaptively induced sequence of lifts.

For every finite set E of distinct nonzero Boolean points and every field L, a subspace of L^E containing all positive-degree monomials of degree at most three and contained in the span of those of degree at most two is the whole function space. Consequently such a space cannot be generated by fewer than |E| columns. Coefficientwise extraction along a linearly independent radical family is uniform over all extension coefficients.

For every field K, finite coordinate type I and finite point type E, and injective point : E -> I -> Bool having a true coordinate at every point, any K-subspace W of E -> K with evaluationSpan point 3 <= W <= evaluationSpan point 2 equals top, where evaluationSpan is generated by actual nonempty coordinate monomials of bounded list length. Every finite column family whose K-span contains W has at least |E| columns. For any field extension A/K and finite K-linearly independent family radicals : R -> A, membership of the radical combination with K-valued coefficient vectors in the A-span of scalar-extended K-columns forces every coefficient vector into their K-span, with arbitrary A-valued column weights. Consequently an independent I^3-indexed radical combination of cubic Boolean evaluations is not in the extended span of fewer than |E| quadratic columns. Radical independence is an explicit hypothesis; this claim does not certify the full finite-field genericity theorem.

import Mathlib

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace LatentGenericity

universe u v w

section BooleanEvaluation

variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {I : Type v} {E : Type w}

def coordinate (point : E → I → Bool) (i : I) : E → K :=
  fun e => if point e i then 1 else 0

def monomial (point : E → I → Bool) : List I → E → K
  | [] => 1
  | i :: m => coordinate point i * monomial point m

def evaluationSpan (point : E → I → Bool) (degree : ℕ) : Submodule K (E → K) :=
  Submodule.span K
    {f | ∃ m : List I, m ≠ [] ∧ m.length ≤ degree ∧ monomial point m = f}

theorem monomial_mem_evaluationSpan (point : E → I → Bool) {degree : ℕ}
    {m : List I} (hne : m ≠ []) (hdegree : m.length ≤ degree) :
    monomial (K := K) point m ∈ evaluationSpan point degree :=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, hne, hdegree, rfl⟩

theorem coordinate_mem_evaluationSpan (point : E → I → Bool) (i : I)
    {degree : ℕ} (hdegree : 1 ≤ degree) :
    coordinate (K := K) point i ∈ evaluationSpan point degree := by
  simpa [monomial] using
    monomial_mem_evaluationSpan (K := K) point (m := [i]) (by simp)
      (by simpa using hdegree)

def multiplyCoordinate (point : E → I → Bool) (i : I) : (E → K) →ₗ[K] (E → K) where
  toFun f := coordinate point i * f
  map_add' f g := by
    ext e
    exact mul_add _ _ _
  map_smul' a f := by
    ext e
    change coordinate point i e * (a * f e) = a * (coordinate point i e * f e)
    ring

theorem coordinate_mul_mem_next (point : E → I → Bool) (i : I)
    {degree : ℕ} {f : E → K} (hf : f ∈ evaluationSpan point degree) :
    coordinate point i * f ∈ evaluationSpan point (degree + 1) := by
  have hmap : evaluationSpan (K := K) point degree ≤
      (evaluationSpan point (degree + 1)).comap (multiplyCoordinate point i) := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro f ⟨m, hne, hdegree, rfl⟩
    change monomial point (i :: m) ∈ evaluationSpan point (degree + 1)
    exact monomial_mem_evaluationSpan point (by simp) (by simpa using hdegree)
  exact hmap hf

theorem sandwich_closed_coordinate (point : E → I → Bool) (W : Submodule K (E → K))
    (hthree : evaluationSpan point 3 ≤ W) (htwo : W ≤ evaluationSpan point 2)
    (i : I) {f : E → K} (hf : f ∈ W) :
    coordinate point i * f ∈ W :=
  hthree (coordinate_mul_mem_next point i (htwo hf))

theorem all_positive_monomials_mem (point : E → I → Bool) (W : Submodule K (E → K))
    (hthree : evaluationSpan point 3 ≤ W) (htwo : W ≤ evaluationSpan point 2)
    (m : List I) : m ≠ [] → monomial point m ∈ W := by
  induction m with
  | nil =>
      intro hne
      exact (hne rfl).elim
  | cons i m ih =>
      intro _
      cases m with
      | nil =>
          simpa [monomial] using
            hthree (coordinate_mem_evaluationSpan (K := K) point i (by omega : 1 ≤ 3))
      | cons j m =>
          exact sandwich_closed_coordinate point W hthree htwo i (ih (by simp))

def selector (point : E → I → Bool) (a : E) (i : I) : E → K :=
  if point a i then coordinate point i else 1 - coordinate point i

theorem selector_self (point : E → I → Bool) (a : E) (i : I) :
    selector (K := K) point a i a = 1 := by
  cases h : point a i <;> simp [selector, coordinate, h]

theorem selector_of_ne (point : E → I → Bool) (a b : E) (i : I)
    (h : point b i ≠ point a i) :
    selector (K := K) point a i b = 0 := by
  cases ha : point a i <;> cases hb : point b i <;>
    simp_all [selector, coordinate]

theorem selector_mul_mem (point : E → I → Bool) (W : Submodule K (E → K))
    (hclosed : ∀ i f, f ∈ W → coordinate point i * f ∈ W)
    (a : E) (i : I) {f : E → K} (hf : f ∈ W) :
    selector point a i * f ∈ W := by
  cases h : point a i with
  | false =>
      simpa [selector, h, sub_mul] using W.sub_mem hf (hclosed i f hf)
  | true =>
      simpa [selector, h] using hclosed i f hf

theorem selector_product_mul_mem (point : E → I → Bool) (W : Submodule K (E → K))
    (hclosed : ∀ i f, f ∈ W → coordinate point i * f ∈ W)
    (a : E) (s : Finset I) {f : E → K} (hf : f ∈ W) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, selector point a i) * f ∈ W := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using hf
  | @insert i s hnot ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hnot, mul_assoc]
      exact selector_mul_mem point W hclosed a i ih

theorem point_indicator_mem [Fintype I] [DecidableEq E] (point : E → I → Bool)
    (hinjective : Function.Injective point) (hnonzero : ∀ a, ∃ i, point a i = true)
    (W : Submodule K (E → K))
    (hcoordinates : ∀ i, coordinate point i ∈ W)
    (hclosed : ∀ i f, f ∈ W → coordinate point i * f ∈ W) (a : E) :
    Pi.single a (1 : K) ∈ W := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hnonzero a
  have hmem := selector_product_mul_mem point W hclosed a Finset.univ (hcoordinates i)
  have heq : (∏ j : I, selector (K := K) point a j) * coordinate point i =
      (Pi.single a (1 : K) : E → K) := by
    ext b
    by_cases hba : b = a
    · subst b
      simp [Finset.prod_apply, selector_self, coordinate, hi]
    · have hpoint : point b ≠ point a := fun h => hba (hinjective h)
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hpoint
      have hzero : (∏ k : I, selector (K := K) point a k b) = 0 :=
        Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j) (selector_of_ne point a b j hj)
      simp [Finset.prod_apply, hzero, hba]
  exact heq ▸ hmem

theorem boolean_evaluation_obstruction [Fintype I] [Fintype E]
    (point : E → I → Bool) (hinjective : Function.Injective point)
    (hnonzero : ∀ a, ∃ i, point a i = true) (W : Submodule K (E → K))
    (hthree : evaluationSpan point 3 ≤ W) (htwo : W ≤ evaluationSpan point 2) :
    W = ⊤ := by
  classical
  have hcoordinates : ∀ i, coordinate (K := K) point i ∈ W :=
    fun i => hthree (coordinate_mem_evaluationSpan point i (by omega : 1 ≤ 3))
  have hclosed : ∀ i f, f ∈ W → coordinate point i * f ∈ W :=
    fun i _ hf => sandwich_closed_coordinate point W hthree htwo i hf
  have hindicators : ∀ a : E, Pi.single a (1 : K) ∈ W :=
    point_indicator_mem point hinjective hnonzero W hcoordinates hclosed
  apply top_unique
  intro f _
  have hdecomposition : f = ∑ a : E, f a • Pi.single a (1 : K) := by
    ext b
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  rw [hdecomposition]
  exact W.sum_mem fun a _ => W.smul_mem (f a) (hindicators a)

theorem generator_card_lower_bound [Fintype I] [Fintype E]
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (point : E → I → Bool)
    (hinjective : Function.Injective point) (hnonzero : ∀ a, ∃ i, point a i = true)
    (W : Submodule K (E → K))
    (hthree : evaluationSpan point 3 ≤ W) (htwo : W ≤ evaluationSpan point 2)
    (columns : J → E → K) (hspans : W ≤ Submodule.span K (Set.range columns)) :
    Fintype.card E ≤ Fintype.card J := by
  have htop : Submodule.span K (Set.range columns) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    simpa [boolean_evaluation_obstruction point hinjective hnonzero W hthree htwo] using
      hspans
  simpa using finrank_le_of_span_eq_top (R := K) htop

def cubicEvaluation (point : E → I → Bool) (indices : I × I × I) : E → K :=
  monomial point [indices.1, indices.2.1, indices.2.2]

theorem coordinate_mul_self (point : E → I → Bool) (i : I) :
    coordinate (K := K) point i * coordinate point i = coordinate point i := by
  ext e
  cases h : point e i <;> simp [coordinate, h]

theorem evaluationSpan_three_eq_cubic_span (point : E → I → Bool) :
    evaluationSpan (K := K) point 3 =
      Submodule.span K (Set.range (cubicEvaluation point)) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro f ⟨m, hne, hdegree, rfl⟩
    cases m with
    | nil => exact (hne rfl).elim
    | cons i m =>
        cases m with
        | nil =>
            have heq : cubicEvaluation (K := K) point (i, i, i) = monomial point [i] := by
              simp only [cubicEvaluation, monomial, mul_one, coordinate_mul_self]
            rw [← heq]
            exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self _)
        | cons j m =>
            cases m with
            | nil =>
                have heq : cubicEvaluation (K := K) point (i, i, j) =
                    monomial point [i, j] := by
                  simp only [cubicEvaluation, monomial, mul_one]
                  rw [← mul_assoc, coordinate_mul_self]
                rw [← heq]
                exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self _)
            | cons k m =>
                cases m with
                | nil =>
                    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨(i, j, k), rfl⟩
                | cons l m =>
                    simp only [List.length_cons] at hdegree
                    omega
  · refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro f ⟨indices, rfl⟩
    exact monomial_mem_evaluationSpan point (by simp) (by simp)

end BooleanEvaluation

section CoefficientExtraction

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] {A : Type*} [Field A] [Algebra K A]
variable {R C E : Type*} [Fintype R] [Fintype C]

def scalarExtend (v : E → K) : E → A :=
  fun e => algebraMap K A (v e)

def radicalCombination (radicals : R → A) (coefficients : R → E → K) : E → A :=
  fun e => ∑ j : R, coefficients j e • radicals j

theorem coefficientwise_extraction (radicals : R → A)
    (hindependent : LinearIndependent K radicals) (coefficients : R → E → K)
    (columns : C → E → K)
    (hmember : radicalCombination radicals coefficients ∈
      Submodule.span A (Set.range (fun j => scalarExtend (A := A) (columns j)))) :
    ∀ j, coefficients j ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range columns) := by
  classical
  intro j
  let projection : Submodule.span K (Set.range radicals) →ₗ[K] K :=
    (Module.Basis.span hindependent).coord j
  obtain ⟨extract, hextend⟩ := projection.exists_extend
  have hextract : ∀ k, extract (radicals k) = if k = j then 1 else 0 := by
    intro k
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hextend
      ⟨radicals k, Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self k)⟩
    simpa [projection, Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.span_repr_eq_single,
      Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm] using h
  have hscalar : ∀ (a : A) (b : K),
      extract (a * algebraMap K A b) = b * extract a := by
    intro a b
    rw [mul_comm, ← Algebra.smul_def]
    exact extract.map_smul b a
  obtain ⟨weights, hweights⟩ :=
    (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun A).mp hmember
  apply (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun K).mpr
  refine ⟨fun k => extract (weights k), ?_⟩
  ext e
  have hpoint := congrFun hweights e
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, scalarExtend, radicalCombination,
    smul_eq_mul] at hpoint
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  calc
    _ = extract (∑ k : C, weights k * algebraMap K A (columns k e)) := by
      simp only [map_sum, hscalar]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => mul_comm _ _
    _ = extract (∑ k : R, coefficients k e • radicals k) := congrArg extract hpoint
    _ = coefficients j e := by
      simp [map_sum, map_smul, hextract, smul_eq_mul]

end CoefficientExtraction

theorem cubic_radical_not_in_small_quadratic_column_span
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {A : Type*} [Field A] [Algebra K A]
    {I E C : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype E] [Fintype C]
    (point : E → I → Bool) (hinjective : Function.Injective point)
    (hnonzero : ∀ a, ∃ i, point a i = true) (columns : C → E → K)
    (hquadratic : ∀ j, columns j ∈ evaluationSpan point 2)
    (hsmall : Fintype.card C < Fintype.card E) (radicals : I × I × I → A)
    (hindependent : LinearIndependent K radicals) :
    radicalCombination (K := K) radicals (cubicEvaluation point) ∉
      Submodule.span A (Set.range (fun j => scalarExtend (A := A) (columns j))) := by
  intro hmember
  let W : Submodule K (E → K) := Submodule.span K (Set.range columns)
  have hextract := coefficientwise_extraction radicals hindependent
    (cubicEvaluation point) columns hmember
  have hthree : evaluationSpan point 3 ≤ W := by
    rw [evaluationSpan_three_eq_cubic_span]
    refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro f ⟨indices, rfl⟩
    exact hextract indices
  have htwo : W ≤ evaluationSpan point 2 := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro f ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact hquadratic j
  have hlower := generator_card_lower_bound point hinjective hnonzero W hthree htwo
    columns le_rfl
  omega

end LatentGenericity

#print axioms LatentGenericity.boolean_evaluation_obstruction
#print axioms LatentGenericity.generator_card_lower_bound
#print axioms LatentGenericity.coefficientwise_extraction
#print axioms LatentGenericity.cubic_radical_not_in_small_quadratic_column_span

claims.natural_statement: Parameter-uniform finite rational potential theorem: arbitrary jointly distributed ranks, bad-space indicators, and adaptive histories satisfying the stated local expected-drop and fresh-genericity bounds have extinction probability at most 1/2 and leaf detection at least 1/4 at harmonic budget depth; a union bound and copy averaging yield 3/16. Every family of compatible linear forms on a surjective parent aggregate factors through one common linear extension map; surjective shift-kernel quotients descend equivariant nonlinear maps.

In a rational-function field in independent variables over F2, the distinct squarefree monomials are linearly independent over the subfield of squares; in particular the r^3 products with one variable from each of three disjoint r-element groups are independent over that subfield, providing the radicals for the genericity obstruction.

For every type σ, let T = Frac(F₂[T_i : i ∈ σ]) and let K = T² be its actual subfield of squares. The squarefree monomials indexed by finitely supported exponents d with each d_i < 2 are K-linearly independent. In particular, for every natural r, the r³ products T_(0,j) T_(1,k) T_(2,l) are K-linearly independent, and their squares are x_(0,j) x_(1,k) x_(2,l), where x_i = T_i² ∈ K. No linear-independence or p-basis hypothesis is assumed.

import Mathlib

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace LatentRadicals

abbrev RootPolynomial (σ : Type*) := MvPolynomial σ (ZMod 2)

abbrev RootField (σ : Type*) := FractionRing (RootPolynomial σ)

def squareSubfield (σ : Type*) : Subfield (RootField σ) :=
  (frobenius (RootField σ) 2).fieldRange

abbrev SquarefreeExponent (σ : Type*) :=
  { d : σ →₀ ℕ // ∀ i, d i < 2 }

def radical {σ : Type*} (d : SquarefreeExponent σ) : RootField σ :=
  algebraMap (RootPolynomial σ) (RootField σ) (MvPolynomial.monomial d.val 1)

def root {σ : Type*} (i : σ) : RootField σ :=
  algebraMap (RootPolynomial σ) (RootField σ) (MvPolynomial.X i)

def squareVariable {σ : Type*} (i : σ) : squareSubfield σ :=
  ⟨root i ^ 2, RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mpr ⟨root i, rfl⟩⟩

theorem mem_squareSubfield_iff {σ : Type*} (z : RootField σ) :
    z ∈ squareSubfield σ ↔ ∃ q : RootField σ, q ^ 2 = z :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem even_add_squarefree_injective {σ : Type*} {a b u v : σ →₀ ℕ}
    (hu : ∀ i, u i < 2) (hv : ∀ i, v i < 2)
    (h : 2 • a + u = 2 • b + v) : a = b ∧ u = v := by
  have hpoint (i : σ) : a i = b i ∧ u i = v i := by
    have he := DFunLike.congr_fun h i
    simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at he
    have hui := hu i
    have hvi := hv i
    omega
  exact ⟨Finsupp.ext (fun i => (hpoint i).1), Finsupp.ext (fun i => (hpoint i).2)⟩

theorem coeff_expand_mul_squarefree {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [DecidableEq σ]
    (u v : SquarefreeExponent σ) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (MvPolynomial.expand 2 p * MvPolynomial.monomial v.val 1).coeff (2 • m + u.val) =
      if u = v then p.coeff m else 0 := by
  classical
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial a c =>
      simp only [MvPolynomial.expand_monomial, MvPolynomial.monomial_mul, mul_one,
        MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
      by_cases huv : u = v
      · subst v
        have he : (2 • a + u.val = 2 • m + u.val) ↔ a = m := by
          constructor
          · intro h
            exact (even_add_squarefree_injective u.property u.property h).1
          · rintro rfl
            rfl
        simp [he]
      · have he : 2 • a + v.val ≠ 2 • m + u.val := by
          intro h
          exact huv (Subtype.ext
            (even_add_squarefree_injective v.property u.property h).2.symm)
        simp only [if_neg huv, if_neg he]
  | add p q hp hq =>
      simp only [map_add, add_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_add, hp, hq]
      split_ifs <;> simp

theorem polynomial_parity_separation {σ ι R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    (d : ι → SquarefreeExponent σ) (hd : Function.Injective d)
    (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → MvPolynomial σ R)
    (h : ∑ i ∈ s, MvPolynomial.expand 2 (p i) * MvPolynomial.monomial (d i).val 1 = 0) :
    ∀ i ∈ s, p i = 0 := by
  classical
  intro i hi
  ext m
  have hc := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff (2 • m + (d i).val)) h
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sum, MvPolynomial.coeff_zero] at hc
  have hs : (∑ j ∈ s,
      (MvPolynomial.expand 2 (p j) * MvPolynomial.monomial (d j).val 1).coeff
        (2 • m + (d i).val)) = (p i).coeff m := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · rw [coeff_expand_mul_squarefree]
      simp
    · intro j hj hji
      rw [coeff_expand_mul_squarefree]
      have hne : d i ≠ d j := fun h => hji (hd h).symm
      simp only [if_neg hne]
    · exact fun hni => (hni hi).elim
  exact hs.symm.trans hc

theorem polynomial_square_separation {σ ι : Type*}
    (d : ι → SquarefreeExponent σ) (hd : Function.Injective d)
    (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → RootPolynomial σ)
    (h : ∑ i ∈ s, (p i) ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.monomial (d i).val 1 = 0) :
    ∀ i ∈ s, p i = 0 :=
  polynomial_parity_separation d hd s p (by
    simpa only [MvPolynomial.expand_zmod] using h)

theorem squarefree_linearIndependent (σ : Type*) :
    LinearIndependent (squareSubfield σ) (radical (σ := σ)) := by
  classical
  apply linearIndependent_iff'.2
  intro s c hrel i hi
  let P := RootPolynomial σ
  let F := RootField σ
  let emb : P →+* F := algebraMap P F
  have hroots : ∀ d : SquarefreeExponent σ, ∃ q : F, q ^ 2 = (c d : F) := by
    intro d
    exact RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mp (c d).property
  choose q hq using hroots
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
    IsLocalization.exist_integer_multiples (nonZeroDivisors P) s q
  have ha' : ∀ d ∈ s, ∃ p : P, emb p = emb (a : P) * q d := by
    intro d hd
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ha d hd
    exact ⟨p, by simpa only [Algebra.smul_def] using hp⟩
  choose! p hp using ha'
  have hzero : ∑ d ∈ s, (p d) ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.monomial d.val 1 = 0 := by
    apply IsFractionRing.injective P F
    rw [map_zero, map_sum]
    calc
      (∑ d ∈ s, emb ((p d) ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.monomial d.val 1)) =
          emb (a : P) ^ 2 * ∑ d ∈ s, c d • radical d := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro d hd
        rw [map_mul, map_pow, hp d hd, mul_pow, hq d]
        change ((emb (a : P)) ^ 2 * (c d : F)) *
            emb (MvPolynomial.monomial d.val 1) =
          (emb (a : P)) ^ 2 * ((c d : F) * emb (MvPolynomial.monomial d.val 1))
        exact mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = 0 := by rw [hrel, mul_zero]
  have hpi : p i = 0 :=
    polynomial_square_separation id Function.injective_id s p hzero i hi
  have hmult : emb (a : P) * q i = 0 := by
    rw [← hp i hi, hpi, map_zero]
  have hane : emb (a : P) ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff emb (IsFractionRing.injective P F)).mpr
      (nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero a)
  have hqi : q i = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hmult).resolve_left hane
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (c i : F) = 0
  rw [← hq i, hqi, zero_pow (by decide)]

def tripleExponent {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r × Fin r × Fin r) :
    SquarefreeExponent (Fin 3 × Fin r) :=
  ⟨Finsupp.single (0, t.1) 1 + Finsupp.single (1, t.2.1) 1 +
      Finsupp.single (2, t.2.2) 1, by
    rintro ⟨row, col⟩
    fin_cases row <;> simp [Finsupp.single_apply, Prod.mk.injEq] <;>
      split_ifs <;> omega⟩

theorem tripleExponent_injective (r : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (tripleExponent (r := r)) := by
  intro t u h
  have he := congrArg Subtype.val h
  have h0 : t.1 = u.1 := by
    by_contra hne
    have ht := DFunLike.congr_fun he (0, t.1)
    simp [tripleExponent, Prod.mk.injEq, Ne.symm hne] at ht
  have h1 : t.2.1 = u.2.1 := by
    by_contra hne
    have ht := DFunLike.congr_fun he (1, t.2.1)
    simp [tripleExponent, Prod.mk.injEq, Ne.symm hne] at ht
  have h2 : t.2.2 = u.2.2 := by
    by_contra hne
    have ht := DFunLike.congr_fun he (2, t.2.2)
    simp [tripleExponent, Prod.mk.injEq, Ne.symm hne] at ht
  exact Prod.ext h0 (Prod.ext h1 h2)

def tripleRadical {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r × Fin r × Fin r) :
    RootField (Fin 3 × Fin r) :=
  root (0, t.1) * root (1, t.2.1) * root (2, t.2.2)

theorem radical_tripleExponent {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r × Fin r × Fin r) :
    radical (tripleExponent t) = tripleRadical t := by
  unfold radical tripleExponent tripleRadical root
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul]
  congr 1
  simp only [MvPolynomial.X, MvPolynomial.monomial_mul, mul_one]

theorem triple_linearIndependent (r : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent (squareSubfield (Fin 3 × Fin r)) (tripleRadical (r := r)) := by
  have h := (squarefree_linearIndependent (Fin 3 × Fin r)).comp
    (tripleExponent (r := r)) (tripleExponent_injective r)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, radical_tripleExponent] using h

theorem tripleRadical_sq {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r × Fin r × Fin r) :
    tripleRadical t ^ 2 =
      (squareVariable ((0 : Fin 3), t.1) : RootField (Fin 3 × Fin r)) *
        (squareVariable ((1 : Fin 3), t.2.1) : RootField (Fin 3 × Fin r)) *
        (squareVariable ((2 : Fin 3), t.2.2) : RootField (Fin 3 × Fin r)) := by
  simp only [tripleRadical, mul_pow, squareVariable]

import Mathlib

namespace LatentSeparation

open Finset

noncomputable section

def expectation {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (w : Ω → ℚ) (f : Ω → ℚ) : ℚ :=
  ∑ ω, w ω * f ω

def indicator {Ω : Type*} (P : Ω → Prop) (ω : Ω) : ℚ := by
  classical
  exact if P ω then 1 else 0

def probability {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (w : Ω → ℚ) (P : Ω → Prop) : ℚ :=
  expectation w (indicator P)

lemma expectation_const {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (w : Ω → ℚ)
    (hw : ∑ ω, w ω = 1) (c : ℚ) :
    expectation w (fun _ => c) = c := by
  simp only [expectation, ← Finset.sum_mul, hw, one_mul]

lemma expectation_sub {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (w f g : Ω → ℚ) :
    expectation w (fun ω => f ω - g ω) = expectation w f - expectation w g := by
  simp [expectation, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

lemma expectation_mul {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (w f : Ω → ℚ) (c : ℚ) :
    expectation w (fun ω => c * f ω) = c * expectation w f := by
  simp only [expectation, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ω _
  ring

lemma expectation_mono {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (w f g : Ω → ℚ)
    (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) (hfg : ∀ ω, f ω ≤ g ω) :
    expectation w f ≤ expectation w g := by
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun ω _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfg ω) (hw ω)

lemma expectation_sum {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (w : Ω → ℚ)
    (f : ℕ → Ω → ℚ) (s : ℕ) :
    expectation w (fun ω => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range s, f j ω) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range s, expectation w (f j) := by
  simp only [expectation, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

lemma telescoping (f : ℕ → ℚ) (s : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range s, (f j - f (j + 1)) = f 0 - f s := by
  induction s with
  | zero => simp
  | succ s ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
    ring

def harmonic (r : ℕ) : ℚ := ∑ j ∈ Finset.range r, 1 / ((j : ℚ) + 1)

lemma harmonic_zero : harmonic 0 = 0 := by simp [harmonic]

lemma harmonic_succ (r : ℕ) :
    harmonic (r + 1) = harmonic r + 1 / ((r : ℚ) + 1) := by
  simp [harmonic, Finset.sum_range_succ]

lemma harmonic_nonneg (r : ℕ) : 0 ≤ harmonic r := by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => by positivity

lemma harmonic_monotone : Monotone harmonic := by
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro r
  rw [harmonic_succ]
  have : 0 ≤ 1 / ((r : ℚ) + 1) := by positivity
  linarith

lemma harmonic_positive {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) : 0 < harmonic r := by
  have h := harmonic_monotone (show 1 ≤ r by omega)
  have h1 : harmonic 1 = 1 := by norm_num [harmonic]
  rw [h1] at h
  linarith

theorem generic_harmonic_drop {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (w : Ω → ℚ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (nextRank : Ω → ℕ)
    (hnext : ∀ ω, nextRank ω ≤ r ∧ r ≤ nextRank ω + 1)
    (θ : ℚ) (hloss : probability w (fun ω => nextRank ω < r) ≤ 3 * (r : ℚ) * θ) :
    expectation w (fun ω => harmonic r - harmonic (nextRank ω)) ≤ 3 * θ := by
  classical
  have hrq : (r : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hr)
  have hpoint : (fun ω => harmonic r - harmonic (nextRank ω)) =
      (fun ω => (1 / (r : ℚ)) * indicator (fun ω => nextRank ω < r) ω) := by
    funext ω
    by_cases hlt : nextRank ω < r
    · have heq : r = nextRank ω + 1 := by obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := hnext ω; omega
      simp only [indicator, if_pos hlt, mul_one]
      rw [heq, harmonic_succ]
      push_cast
      ring
    · have heq : nextRank ω = r := by obtain ⟨h, _⟩ := hnext ω; omega
      simp [indicator, heq]
  rw [hpoint, expectation_mul]
  change (1 / (r : ℚ)) * probability w (fun ω => nextRank ω < r) ≤ 3 * θ
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 / (r : ℚ)) * (3 * (r : ℚ) * θ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hloss (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by field_simp

theorem arbitrary_harmonic_drop {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (w : Ω → ℚ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) (r r₀ : ℕ) (hr : r ≤ r₀)
    (nextRank : Ω → ℕ) (hnext : ∀ ω, nextRank ω ≤ r)
    (θ : ℚ)
    (hloss : probability w (fun ω => nextRank ω < r) ≤ (2 : ℚ) ^ r₀ * θ) :
    expectation w (fun ω => harmonic r - harmonic (nextRank ω)) ≤
      harmonic r₀ * (2 : ℚ) ^ r₀ * θ := by
  classical
  have hpoint (ω : Ω) :
      harmonic r - harmonic (nextRank ω) ≤
        harmonic r₀ * indicator (fun ω => nextRank ω < r) ω := by
    by_cases hlt : nextRank ω < r
    · simp only [indicator, if_pos hlt, mul_one]
      have h := harmonic_monotone hr
      have hn := harmonic_nonneg (nextRank ω)
      linarith
    · have heq : nextRank ω = r := by have := hnext ω; omega
      simp [indicator, heq]
  calc
    _ ≤ expectation w
        (fun ω => harmonic r₀ * indicator (fun ω => nextRank ω < r) ω) :=
      expectation_mono _ _ _ hw hpoint
    _ = harmonic r₀ * probability w (fun ω => nextRank ω < r) := expectation_mul _ _ _
    _ ≤ harmonic r₀ * ((2 : ℚ) ^ r₀ * θ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hloss (harmonic_nonneg r₀)
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem adaptive_rank_survival {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (w : Ω → ℚ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) (hnorm : ∑ ω, w ω = 1)
    (rank : ℕ → Ω → ℕ) (H : ℕ → ℚ) (r₀ s : ℕ)
    (hH : Monotone H) (hzero : H 0 = 0) (hpos : 0 < H r₀)
    (hroot : ∀ ω, rank 0 ω = r₀) (hterminal : ∀ ω, rank s ω ≤ r₀)
    (bad : ℕ → Ω → Prop) (θ K ε : ℚ)
    (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hε : K * ε ≤ 1)
    (hbad : ∀ j < s, probability w (bad j) ≤ ε)
    (hdrop : ∀ j < s,
      expectation w (fun ω => H (rank j ω) - H (rank (j + 1) ω)) ≤
        3 * θ + K * θ * probability w (bad j))
    (hdepth : 8 * (s : ℚ) * θ ≤ H r₀)
    (detect : Ω → ℚ)
    (hleaf : ∀ ω, (if rank s ω = 0 then (0 : ℚ) else 1 / 2) ≤ detect ω) :
    probability w (fun ω => rank s ω = 0) ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
      1 / 4 ≤ expectation w detect := by
  classical
  have hstep (j : ℕ) (hj : j < s) :
      expectation w (fun ω => H (rank j ω) - H (rank (j + 1) ω)) ≤ 4 * θ := by
    have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbad j hj) (mul_nonneg hK hθ)
    have he := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hε hθ
    nlinarith [hdrop j hj]
  have hsum :
      expectation w (fun ω => H r₀ - H (rank s ω)) ≤ (s : ℚ) * (4 * θ) := by
    have heq : (fun ω => H r₀ - H (rank s ω)) =
        (fun ω => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range s, (H (rank j ω) - H (rank (j + 1) ω))) := by
      funext ω
      rw [telescoping, hroot]
    rw [heq, expectation_sum]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range s, (4 * θ) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj => hstep j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hloss :
      H r₀ * probability w (fun ω => rank s ω = 0) ≤
        expectation w (fun ω => H r₀ - H (rank s ω)) := by
    rw [probability, ← expectation_mul]
    apply expectation_mono _ _ _ hw
    intro ω
    by_cases hr : rank s ω = 0
    · simp [indicator, hr, hzero]
    · simp only [indicator, if_neg hr, mul_zero]
      exact sub_nonneg.mpr (hH (hterminal ω))
  have hext : probability w (fun ω => rank s ω = 0) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨hext, ?_⟩
  have hle := expectation_mono w
    (fun ω => if rank s ω = 0 then (0 : ℚ) else 1 / 2) detect hw hleaf
  have heq : (fun ω => if rank s ω = 0 then (0 : ℚ) else 1 / 2) =
      (fun ω => (1 / 2 : ℚ) * ((1 : ℚ) - indicator (fun ω => rank s ω = 0) ω)) := by
    funext ω
    by_cases hr : rank s ω = 0 <;> simp [indicator, hr]
  rw [heq, expectation_mul, expectation_sub, expectation_const w hnorm] at hle
  change (1 / 2 : ℚ) * (1 - probability w (fun ω => rank s ω = 0)) ≤
    expectation w detect at hle
  linarith

theorem probability_union_bound {Ω I : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype I]
    (w : Ω → ℚ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) (P : I → Ω → Prop) :
    probability w (fun ω => ∃ i, P i ω) ≤ ∑ i, probability w (P i) := by
  classical
  have hpoint (ω : Ω) :
      indicator (fun ω => ∃ i, P i ω) ω ≤ ∑ i, indicator (P i) ω := by
    by_cases he : ∃ i, P i ω
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := he
      have h := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => indicator (P i) ω)
        (fun j _ => by simp [indicator]; split_ifs <;> norm_num) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      calc
        indicator (fun ω => ∃ i, P i ω) ω = 1 := by
          simp only [indicator, if_pos (show ∃ i, P i ω from ⟨i, hi⟩)]
        _ = indicator (P i) ω := by simp only [indicator, if_pos hi]
        _ ≤ _ := h
    · simp only [indicator, if_neg he]
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by
        split_ifs <;> norm_num
  calc
    _ ≤ expectation w (fun ω => ∑ i, indicator (P i) ω) :=
      expectation_mono _ _ _ hw hpoint
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [expectation, probability, Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_comm

theorem injection_failure_bound {Ω I : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype I]
    (w : Ω → ℚ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) (P : I → Ω → Prop)
    (b : ℕ) (hcard : Fintype.card I ≤ 2 ^ b)
    (hmarginal : ∀ i, probability w (P i) ≤ 1 / (4 * (2 : ℚ) ^ b)) :
    probability w (fun ω => ∃ i, P i ω) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
  have hpow : 0 < (2 : ℚ) ^ b := by positivity
  have hcount : (Fintype.card I : ℚ) ≤ (2 : ℚ) ^ b := by exact_mod_cast hcard
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, probability w (P i) := probability_union_bound w hw P
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : I, 1 / (4 * (2 : ℚ) ^ b) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hmarginal i
    _ = (Fintype.card I : ℚ) * (1 / (4 * (2 : ℚ) ^ b)) := by simp
    _ ≤ (2 : ℚ) ^ b * (1 / (4 * (2 : ℚ) ^ b)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcount (by positivity)
    _ = 1 / 4 := by field_simp

theorem copy_average_detection {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    (w : Ω → ℚ) (hw : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ w ω) (hnorm : ∑ ω, w ω = 1)
    (bad : Ω → Prop) (detect : Ω → ℚ)
    (hbad : probability w bad ≤ 1 / 4)
    (hdetect : ∀ ω, (1 / 4 : ℚ) * (1 - indicator bad ω) ≤ detect ω) :
    3 / 16 ≤ expectation w detect := by
  classical
  have hle := expectation_mono w
    (fun ω => (1 / 4 : ℚ) * (1 - indicator bad ω)) detect hw hdetect
  rw [expectation_mul, expectation_sub, expectation_const w hnorm] at hle
  change (1 / 4 : ℚ) * (1 - probability w bad) ≤ expectation w detect at hle
  linarith

section LinearFactorization

variable {F S T X B : Type*} [Field F]
  [AddCommGroup S] [Module F S] [AddCommGroup T] [Module F T]
  [AddCommGroup X] [Module F X] [AddCommGroup B] [Module F B]

theorem common_extension_map
    (aX : T →ₗ[F] X) (aB : T →ₗ[F] B) (haX : Function.Surjective aX)
    (characters : S →ₗ[F] (B →ₗ[F] F)) (forms : S →ₗ[F] (T →ₗ[F] F))
    (hcompatible : ∀ z t, aX t = 0 → forms z t = characters z (aB t)) :
    ∃ γ : S →ₗ[F] (X →ₗ[F] F),
      ∀ z t, forms z t = γ z (aX t) + characters z (aB t) := by
  obtain ⟨sec, hsec⟩ := aX.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr haX)
  have hsec' : ∀ x, aX (sec x) = x := LinearMap.ext_iff.mp hsec
  let γ : S →ₗ[F] (X →ₗ[F] F) :=
    { toFun := fun z => (forms z - (characters z).comp aB).comp sec
      map_add' := by intros; ext; simp; ring
      map_smul' := by intros; ext; simp; ring }
  refine ⟨γ, ?_⟩
  intro z t
  have hk : aX (t - sec (aX t)) = 0 := by simp [hsec']
  have h := hcompatible z (t - sec (aX t)) hk
  simp only [map_sub] at h
  change forms z t =
    (forms z (sec (aX t)) - characters z (aB (sec (aX t)))) +
      characters z (aB t)
  linear_combination h

end LinearFactorization

section Quotients

variable {P V B R : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [AddCommGroup V]
  [AddCommGroup B] [AddCommGroup R]

theorem shift_kernel_descent
    (q : P →+ V) (embed : B →+ V) (ι : R →+ P) (lam : R →+ B)
    (hq : Function.Surjective q) (hlam : Function.Surjective lam)
    (hinclude : Function.Injective ι)
    (hker : ∀ n, q n = 0 ↔ ∃ h, ι h = n ∧ lam h = 0)
    (hcompat : ∀ h, q (ι h) = embed (lam h))
    (C : P → B) (hequiv : ∀ x h, C (x + ι h) = C x + lam h) :
    Function.Injective embed ∧
      ∃ Cbar : V → B, (∀ x, Cbar (q x) = C x) ∧
        ∀ v b, Cbar (v + embed b) = Cbar v + b := by
  classical
  have hczero (b : B) (hb : embed b = 0) : b = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hlam b
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkzero⟩ := (hker (ι h)).mp ((hcompat h).trans hb)
    have hkh : k = h := hinclude hk
    simpa [hkh] using hkzero
  have hinj : Function.Injective embed := by
    intro a b hab
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    apply hczero
    simpa using congrArg (fun x => x - embed b) hab
  have hfibre (x y : P) (hxy : q x = q y) : C x = C y := by
    have hkq : q (x - y) = 0 := by simp [hxy]
    obtain ⟨h, hdiff, hzero⟩ := (hker (x - y)).mp hkq
    have heq := hequiv y h
    have hxyadd : y + ι h = x := by rw [hdiff]; abel
    rw [hxyadd, hzero, add_zero] at heq
    exact heq
  let Cbar : V → B := fun v => C (Classical.choose (hq v))
  have hbar (x : P) : Cbar (q x) = C x :=
    hfibre _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (hq (q x)))
  refine ⟨hinj, Cbar, hbar, ?_⟩
  intro v b
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hq v
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hlam b
  rw [← hcompat, ← map_add, hbar, hbar, hequiv]

end Quotients

import research.latent_separation.genericity.Main
import research.latent_separation.radicals.Main

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators
open LatentGenericity LatentRadicals

namespace LatentAlignment

abbrev Variables (r : ℕ) := Fin 3 × Fin r
abbrev Polynomial (r : ℕ) := RootPolynomial (Variables r)
abbrev FunctionField (r : ℕ) := RootField (Variables r)
abbrev SquareField (r : ℕ) : Type := ↥(squareSubfield (Variables r))

variable {r : ℕ} {E : Type*}

def column (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (ij : Variables r) : E → SquareField r :=
  fun e => ∑ k : Fin r, (squareVariable (ij.1, k) : SquareField r) *
    coordinate (K := SquareField r) point ij.2 e *
      coordinate (K := SquareField r) point k e

theorem weighted_pairs_quadratic {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (weights : Fin r → K) (j : Fin r) :
    (fun e => ∑ k : Fin r, weights k * coordinate (K := K) point j e *
      coordinate (K := K) point k e) ∈ evaluationSpan point 2 := by
  have heq : (fun e => ∑ k : Fin r, weights k * coordinate (K := K) point j e *
      coordinate (K := K) point k e) =
      ∑ k : Fin r, weights k •
        (coordinate (K := K) point j * coordinate (K := K) point k) := by
    ext e
    simp [mul_assoc]
  rw [heq]
  apply (evaluationSpan (K := K) point 2).sum_mem
  intro k _
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  simpa only [monomial, mul_one] using
    monomial_mem_evaluationSpan (K := K) point (m := [j, k]) (by simp) (by simp)

theorem column_quadratic (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (ij : Variables r) :
    column point ij ∈ evaluationSpan point 2 :=
  weighted_pairs_quadratic point (fun k => squareVariable (ij.1, k)) ij.2

def linearPolynomial (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (i : Fin 3) (e : E) :
    Polynomial r :=
  ∑ j : Fin r, MvPolynomial.X (i, j) * (if point e j then 1 else 0)

def zPolynomial (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (i : Fin 3) (e : E) :
    Polynomial r :=
  ∑ j : Fin r, MvPolynomial.X (i, j) ^ 2 * (if point e j then 1 else 0)

def matrixPolynomial (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (e : E) (ij : Variables r) :
    Polynomial r :=
  (if point e ij.2 then 1 else 0) * zPolynomial point ij.1 e

def responsePolynomial (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (e : E) : Polynomial r :=
  linearPolynomial point 0 e * linearPolynomial point 1 e * linearPolynomial point 2 e

def response (point : E → Fin r → Bool) : E → FunctionField r :=
  fun e => algebraMap (Polynomial r) (FunctionField r) (responsePolynomial point e)

theorem linearPolynomial_sq (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (i : Fin 3) (e : E) :
    linearPolynomial point i e ^ 2 = zPolynomial point i e := by
  unfold linearPolynomial zPolynomial
  rw [CharTwo.sum_sq]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  cases point e j <;> simp

theorem responsePolynomial_sq (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (e : E) :
    responsePolynomial point e ^ 2 =
      zPolynomial point 0 e * zPolynomial point 1 e * zPolynomial point 2 e := by
  simp only [responsePolynomial, mul_pow, linearPolynomial_sq]

theorem matrixPolynomial_map (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (e : E) (ij : Variables r) :
    algebraMap (Polynomial r) (FunctionField r) (matrixPolynomial point e ij) =
      scalarExtend (A := FunctionField r) (column point ij) e := by
  classical
  simp only [matrixPolynomial, zPolynomial, column, scalarExtend, coordinate,
    map_mul, map_sum, map_pow, apply_ite, map_one, map_zero, squareVariable, root]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  cases point e ij.2 <;> cases point e j <;> simp
  rfl

theorem response_eq_radicalCombination (point : E → Fin r → Bool) :
    response point =
      radicalCombination (K := SquareField r) tripleRadical (cubicEvaluation point) := by
  classical
  ext e
  simp only [response, responsePolynomial, linearPolynomial, map_mul, map_sum,
    apply_ite, map_one, map_zero, radicalCombination, cubicEvaluation, monomial,
    coordinate, Pi.mul_apply, mul_one, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
    Algebra.smul_def, tripleRadical, root]
  rw [Fintype.sum_mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro l _
  cases point e j <;> cases point e k <;> cases point e l <;> simp

theorem actual_matrix_nonmembership [Fintype E]
    (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (hinjective : Function.Injective point)
    (hnonzero : ∀ e, ∃ j, point e j = true) (hlarge : 3 * r < Fintype.card E) :
    response point ∉ Submodule.span (FunctionField r)
      (Set.range (fun ij : Variables r =>
        fun e => algebraMap (Polynomial r) (FunctionField r) (matrixPolynomial point e ij))) := by
  have hsmall : Fintype.card (Variables r) < Fintype.card E := by
    simpa [Variables, Fintype.card_prod] using hlarge
  have h := cubic_radical_not_in_small_quadratic_column_span point hinjective hnonzero
    (column point) (column_quadratic point) hsmall tripleRadical
    (triple_linearIndependent r)
  rw [← response_eq_radicalCombination] at h
  simpa only [matrixPolynomial_map] using h

section Minors

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [Fintype E]

theorem independent_has_minor (v : J → E → K) (hv : LinearIndependent K v) :
    ∃ rows : J → E, (Matrix.of (fun i j => v j (rows i))).det ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  let M : Matrix E J K := fun e j => v j e
  have hrank : M.rank = Fintype.card J := by
    rw [← Matrix.rank_transpose]
    exact hv.rank_matrix
  obtain ⟨κ, a, ha, hspan, hli⟩ := exists_linearIndependent' K M.row
  letI : Finite κ := Finite.of_injective a ha
  letI : Fintype κ := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  have hcard : Fintype.card κ = Fintype.card J := by
    calc
      Fintype.card κ = Module.finrank K
          (Submodule.span K (Set.range (M.row ∘ a))) :=
        linearIndependent_iff_card_eq_finrank_span.mp hli
      _ = M.rank := by rw [hspan, Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_span_row]
      _ = Fintype.card J := hrank
  let e : J ≃ κ := Fintype.equivOfCardEq hcard.symm
  let B : Matrix J J K := fun i j => M (a (e i)) j
  have hB : LinearIndependent K B.row := hli.comp e e.injective
  exact ⟨a ∘ e,
    (B.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det.mp (Matrix.linearIndependent_rows_iff_isUnit.mp hB)).ne_zero⟩

end Minors

section AugmentedDeterminants

variable {S : Type*} [CommRing S] {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]

def augmentedSquare (w : J → E → S) (rows : Option J → E) (v : E → S) :
    Matrix (Option J) (Option J) S :=
  fun i j => j.elim (v (rows i)) (fun k => w k (rows i))

omit [Fintype J] in
theorem augmentedSquare_update (w : J → E → S) (rows : Option J → E) (v : E → S) :
    augmentedSquare w rows v =
      (augmentedSquare w rows 0).updateCol none (fun i => v (rows i)) := by
  ext i j
  cases j <;> simp [augmentedSquare]

def augmentedDet (w : J → E → S) (rows : Option J → E) : (E → S) →ₗ[S] S where
  toFun v := (augmentedSquare w rows v).det
  map_add' u v := by
    rw [augmentedSquare_update w rows (u + v), augmentedSquare_update w rows u,
      augmentedSquare_update w rows v]
    exact Matrix.det_updateCol_add _ none _ _
  map_smul' a v := by
    rw [augmentedSquare_update w rows (a • v), augmentedSquare_update w rows v]
    simpa only [RingHom.id_apply, Pi.smul_def, smul_eq_mul] using
      Matrix.det_updateCol_smul (augmentedSquare w rows 0) none a (fun i => v (rows i))

theorem augmentedDet_column (w : J → E → S) (rows : Option J → E) (j : J) :
    augmentedDet w rows (w j) = 0 := by
  apply Matrix.det_zero_of_column_eq (i := none) (j := some j) (by simp)
  intro i
  rfl

theorem augmentedDet_of_mem (w : J → E → S) (rows : Option J → E) {v : E → S}
    (hv : v ∈ Submodule.span S (Set.range w)) : augmentedDet w rows v = 0 := by
  have hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range w) ≤ LinearMap.ker (augmentedDet w rows) := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact augmentedDet_column w rows j
  exact hspan hv

theorem map_augmentedDet {S' : Type*} [CommRing S'] (f : S →+* S')
    (w : J → E → S) (rows : Option J → E) (v : E → S) :
    f (augmentedDet w rows v) =
      augmentedDet (fun j e => f (w j e)) rows (fun e => f (v e)) := by
  change f (augmentedSquare w rows v).det = _
  rw [f.map_det]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  cases j <;> rfl

end AugmentedDeterminants

section Degrees

theorem linearPolynomial_degree (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (i : Fin 3) (e : E) :
    (linearPolynomial point i e).totalDegree ≤ 1 := by
  apply MvPolynomial.totalDegree_finsetSum_le
  intro j _
  cases point e j <;> simp

theorem zPolynomial_degree (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (i : Fin 3) (e : E) :
    (zPolynomial point i e).totalDegree ≤ 2 := by
  apply MvPolynomial.totalDegree_finsetSum_le
  intro j _
  cases point e j <;> simp

theorem matrixPolynomial_degree (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (e : E) (ij : Variables r) :
    (matrixPolynomial point e ij).totalDegree ≤ 2 := by
  cases h : point e ij.2 <;> simp [matrixPolynomial, h, zPolynomial_degree]

theorem responsePolynomial_degree (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (e : E) :
    (responsePolynomial point e).totalDegree ≤ 3 := by
  have h0 := linearPolynomial_degree point (0 : Fin 3) e
  have h1 := linearPolynomial_degree point (1 : Fin 3) e
  have h2 := linearPolynomial_degree point (2 : Fin 3) e
  have h01 := MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul
    (linearPolynomial point 0 e) (linearPolynomial point 1 e)
  have h012 := MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul
    (linearPolynomial point 0 e * linearPolynomial point 1 e) (linearPolynomial point 2 e)
  unfold responsePolynomial
  omega

theorem determinant_degree {σ N : Type*} [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N]
    (M : Matrix N N (MvPolynomial σ (ZMod 2))) (bounds : N → ℕ)
    (hdegree : ∀ i j, (M i j).totalDegree ≤ bounds j) :
    M.det.totalDegree ≤ ∑ j : N, bounds j := by
  rw [Matrix.det_apply]
  apply MvPolynomial.totalDegree_finsetSum_le
  intro p _
  rw [Units.smul_def]
  apply (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_smul_le (p.sign : ℤ) _).trans
  apply (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_finsetProd _ _).trans
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hdegree (p j) j

theorem augmentedDet_degree {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    (w : J → E → Polynomial r) (rows : Option J → E) (v : E → Polynomial r)
    {D d : ℕ} (hw : ∀ j e, (w j e).totalDegree ≤ D)
    (hv : ∀ e, (v e).totalDegree ≤ d) :
    (augmentedDet w rows v).totalDegree ≤ Fintype.card J * D + d := by
  have h := determinant_degree (augmentedSquare w rows v)
    (fun j => j.elim d (fun _ => D)) (by
      intro i j
      cases j with
      | none => exact hv (rows i)
      | some j => exact hw j (rows i))
  simpa [augmentedDet, Fintype.sum_option, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.add_comm] using h

end Degrees

def Aligned {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (point : E → Fin r → Bool)
    (f : Polynomial r →+* S) : Prop :=
  (fun e => f (responsePolynomial point e)) ∈ Submodule.span S
    (Set.range (fun ij : Variables r => fun e => f (matrixPolynomial point e ij)))

theorem exists_alignment_polynomial [Fintype E]
    (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (hinjective : Function.Injective point)
    (hnonzero : ∀ e, ∃ j, point e j = true) (hlarge : 3 * r < Fintype.card E) :
    ∃ P : Polynomial r, P ≠ 0 ∧ P.totalDegree ≤ 6 * r + 3 ∧
      ∀ (S : Type*) [CommRing S] (f : Polynomial r →+* S),
        Aligned point f → f P = 0 := by
  classical
  let emb : Polynomial r →+* FunctionField r := algebraMap _ _
  let v : Variables r → E → FunctionField r :=
    fun ij e => emb (matrixPolynomial point e ij)
  obtain ⟨J, a, ha, hspan, hli⟩ := exists_linearIndependent' (FunctionField r) v
  letI : Finite J := Finite.of_injective a ha
  letI : Fintype J := Fintype.ofFinite J
  let w : J → E → Polynomial r := fun j e => matrixPolynomial point e (a j)
  have hc : response point ∉
      Submodule.span (FunctionField r) (Set.range (v ∘ a)) := by
    rw [hspan]
    exact actual_matrix_nonmembership point hinjective hnonzero hlarge
  let b : Option J → E → FunctionField r :=
    fun j => j.casesOn' (response point) (v ∘ a)
  have hb : LinearIndependent (FunctionField r) b := hli.option hc
  obtain ⟨rows, hminor⟩ := independent_has_minor b hb
  let P : Polynomial r := augmentedDet w rows (responsePolynomial point)
  have hP : P ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hnonzero : augmentedDet (fun j e => emb (w j e)) rows
        (fun e => emb (responsePolynomial point e)) ≠ 0 := by
      change (augmentedSquare (fun j e => emb (w j e)) rows
        (fun e => emb (responsePolynomial point e))).det ≠ 0
      have heq : augmentedSquare (fun j e => emb (w j e)) rows
          (fun e => emb (responsePolynomial point e)) =
          Matrix.of (fun i j => b j (rows i)) := by
        ext i j
        cases j <;> rfl
      rw [heq]
      exact hminor
    apply hnonzero
    rw [← map_augmentedDet]
    exact congrArg emb hzero |>.trans (map_zero emb)
  have hcard : Fintype.card J ≤ 3 * r := by
    calc
      Fintype.card J ≤ Fintype.card (Variables r) := Fintype.card_le_of_injective a ha
      _ = 3 * r := by simp [Variables]
  have hdegree : P.totalDegree ≤ 6 * r + 3 := by
    have hbound := augmentedDet_degree w rows (responsePolynomial point)
      (D := 2) (d := 3) (fun j e => matrixPolynomial_degree point e (a j))
      (responsePolynomial_degree point)
    change P.totalDegree ≤ _ at hbound
    omega
  have hzero : ∀ ij : Variables r,
      augmentedDet w rows (fun e => matrixPolynomial point e ij) = 0 := by
    intro ij
    apply IsFractionRing.injective (Polynomial r) (FunctionField r)
    rw [map_augmentedDet, map_zero]
    apply augmentedDet_of_mem
    change v ij ∈ Submodule.span (FunctionField r) (Set.range (v ∘ a))
    rw [hspan]
    exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self ij)
  refine ⟨P, hP, hdegree, ?_⟩
  intro S _ f haligned
  change f (augmentedDet w rows (responsePolynomial point)) = 0
  rw [map_augmentedDet]
  have hker : Submodule.span S
      (Set.range (fun ij : Variables r => fun e => f (matrixPolynomial point e ij))) ≤
      LinearMap.ker (augmentedDet (fun j e => f (w j e)) rows) := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨ij, rfl⟩
    change augmentedDet (fun j e => f (w j e)) rows
      (fun e => f (matrixPolynomial point e ij)) = 0
    rw [← map_augmentedDet, hzero ij, map_zero]
  exact hker haligned

def specialize {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [CharP S 2] (T : Variables r → S) :
    Polynomial r →+* S :=
  MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl 2) S) T

theorem specialize_matrix {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [CharP S 2]
    (T : Variables r → S) (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (e : E) (ij : Variables r) :
    specialize T (matrixPolynomial point e ij) =
      (if point e ij.2 then 1 else 0) *
        ∑ k : Fin r, T (ij.1, k) ^ 2 * (if point e k then 1 else 0) := by
  cases h : point e ij.2 <;>
    simp [specialize, matrixPolynomial, zPolynomial, h, apply_ite]

theorem specialize_response {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [CharP S 2]
    (T : Variables r → S) (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (e : E) :
    specialize T (responsePolynomial point e) =
      (∑ j : Fin r, T (0, j) * (if point e j then 1 else 0)) *
        (∑ j : Fin r, T (1, j) * (if point e j then 1 else 0)) *
        (∑ j : Fin r, T (2, j) * (if point e j then 1 else 0)) := by
  simp [specialize, responsePolynomial, linearPolynomial, apply_ite]

theorem specialized_response_unique_square_root {S : Type*} [Field S] [CharP S 2]
    (T : Variables r → S) (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (e : E) (y : S) :
    y ^ 2 = specialize T (zPolynomial point 0 e) *
        specialize T (zPolynomial point 1 e) * specialize T (zPolynomial point 2 e) ↔
      y = specialize T (responsePolynomial point e) := by
  have hc := congrArg (specialize T) (responsePolynomial_sq point e)
  simp only [map_pow, map_mul] at hc
  constructor
  · intro hy
    apply (frobenius S 2).injective
    exact hy.trans hc.symm
  · rintro rfl
    exact hc

theorem exists_alignment_polynomial_specialization [Fintype E]
    (point : E → Fin r → Bool) (hinjective : Function.Injective point)
    (hnonzero : ∀ e, ∃ j, point e j = true) (hlarge : 3 * r < Fintype.card E) :
    ∃ P : Polynomial r, P ≠ 0 ∧ P.totalDegree ≤ 6 * r + 3 ∧
      ∀ (S : Type*) [CommRing S] [CharP S 2] (T : Variables r → S),
        (∃ weights : Variables r → S, ∀ e,
          (∑ ij : Variables r, weights ij *
            ((if point e ij.2 then 1 else 0) *
              ∑ k : Fin r, T (ij.1, k) ^ 2 * (if point e k then 1 else 0))) =
            (∑ j : Fin r, T (0, j) * (if point e j then 1 else 0)) *
              (∑ j : Fin r, T (1, j) * (if point e j then 1 else 0)) *
              (∑ j : Fin r, T (2, j) * (if point e j then 1 else 0))) →
        specialize T P = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hdegree, hvanish⟩ :=
    exists_alignment_polynomial point hinjective hnonzero hlarge
  refine ⟨P, hP, hdegree, ?_⟩
  intro S _ _ T hweights
  apply hvanish S (specialize T)
  obtain ⟨weights, hweights⟩ := hweights
  apply (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun S).mpr
  refine ⟨weights, ?_⟩
  ext e
  simpa only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, specialize_matrix,
    specialize_response] using hweights e
